modelDescription: The CVA Scout V2 single shot takedown break action rifles is one of the most affordable, factory upgraded break-action centerfire rifles available on the market today. The CVA Scout makes an excellent choice for young children as a firearm that can teach shooting fundamentals, or a camp/brush gun. Every CVA Scout model features a perfectly balanced 100% ambidextrous design making it incredible quick to aim and extremely accurate to shoot.
